item.title: Debbie Abrams, local radio host, ends 30-year run at ‘kick in the pants’ gig at KZST
item.description: Debbie Abrams was a morning voice on KZST for three decades. Friday marked her final show on the Santa Rosa radio station.

item.title: With WBC departures, more opportunities emerging in SF Giants camp
item.description: Luis Matos, Jerar Encarnacion and Will Brennan are among those competing for a spot on the Giants' bench

item.title: Following Clearlake rescue, dozens of dogs make full recoveries at Humane Society of Sonoma County
item.description: The dogs were transferred from Clearlake to the Sonoma County Humane Society after allegations arose against North Bay Animal Services that more than 110 dogs were living in deplorable conditions.

item.title: The Bohemian Grove members in our midst: Leaked list shows local roster for exclusive summer encampment
item.description: A leaked list of Bohemian Grove attendees has sparked new intrigue over the exclusive summer gathering along the Russian River. The Press Democrat combed the roster and identified dozens of men with ties to Sonoma and Napa counties.

item.title: Pentagon’s chief tech officer says he clashed with AI company Anthropic over autonomous warfare
item.description: Anthropic has vowed to sue over the designation.

item.title: Man accused of tricking hundreds of teens into sending him pornographic images is brought to US
item.description: Zobaidul Amin pleaded not guilty during an initial court appearance in Anchorage on Thursday.

item.title: James Gallagher, Audrey Denney officially enter congressional race
item.description: Audrey Denney and Assemblyman James Gallagher have formally entered both races for Congressional District 1 this week after filing the paperwork and taking the oaths.

item.title: David Rabbitt won’t seek fifth term on Sonoma County Board of Supervisors
item.description: Rabbitt's move, announced hours before the regular filing deadline Friday, means the county will have a second race in the June election for an open seat on the five-member board.

item.title: SF Giants’ Webb shakes off shocking homer, pitches four strong innings in Team USA’s victory over Brazil
item.description: Webb allowed a leadoff homer to the son of Manny Ramirez before retiring the next 12 batters he faced
